# Guarded run: frozen controllers on new git traffic, then the enforcing proxy

*Generated by `real-mcp/analysis/guarded_report.py` from `real-mcp/results_guarded/`; every receipt digest is checked, the run's harness, installation, contract and served-definition digests are checked against the reported run, and the controller, policy and proxy code against the digests in the manifest.*

Seeds 32–41 of the pilot's traffic generator, which no earlier run used; frozen harness (`pilot2/`, same digest as the reported run), official git server `mcp-server-git==2026.10.28`, private network namespace, on a third Linux machine.  The four controllers were fixed and written to `results_guarded/manifest.json` at 2026-11-03T09:22:43.946205+00:00, before the first call; the tree and the per-tool baseline were fitted on controller seeds 7–8 only.

## 1. Shadow phase: verdicts recorded before every read-only call, every call executed

10 seeds, 480 calls, 220 read-only calls, 17 index rewrites by read-only tools (per seed: 32: 2/22, 33: 2/22, 34: 1/22, 35: 1/22, 36: 2/22, 37: 2/22, 38: 1/22, 39: 2/22, 40: 2/22, 41: 2/22).

| Controller | Reviews | Rewrites flagged | Reviews without rewrite | Rewrites allowed |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| S — index state read before the call | 17/220 | 17/17 | 0 | 0 |
| P2 — history since the last `git_reset` | 17/220 | 17/17 | 0 | 0 |
| Depth-2 tree selected on seeds 7–8 | 20/220 | 17/17 | 3 | 0 |
| Per-tool baseline fitted on seeds 7–8 | 80/220 | 12/17 | 68 | 5 |

S decided all 220 read-only calls correctly with its verdict recorded before execution: 17 of 17 rewrites flagged, 0 reviews without a rewrite, 0 rewrites allowed.  The tree selected on seeds 7–8 flagged 17 of 17 with 3 additional reviews; the per-tool baseline allowed 5 rewrites and raised 68 additional reviews.

## 2. Enforce phase: `runtime/mcp_proxy.py` in front of the unmodified server

The same seeds again.  The proxy attests the installation, the contract and the served `tools/list` against `runtime/pins/git.json` (the reported run's digests), evaluates S on the index before every call, fsyncs the decision to its hash-chained ledger and forwards only allowed calls.

| Calls | Forwarded (attested) | Held | Held calls with a process or file event | Read-only calls | Index rewrites by read-only calls |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 480 | 415 (415) | 65 | 0 | 220 | 0 |

Held calls by tool: `git_diff` 8, `git_diff_unstaged` 10, `git_status` 47.

No held call reached the server: the kernel's process events, which record `git` processes for 116 of the forwarded calls, show none for any of the 65 held calls, and the sandbox snapshots show no file change for them.  No read-only call rewrote the index.  A held `git_status` leaves the stale index in place for the next worktree reader, so under enforcement without a reviewer 65 reader calls were held where the shadow phase reviewed 17; how a review is resolved (approve once, refresh, deny) is the operational parameter WP2 measures.
